content: Fitor edde Yuhannare ḍõr šobar sarme ana oiye
Hitara ehono mainšor loi hota howat ase, hen šomot imam okkol edde dórmogór sõloya okkolor boro edde Sadduki okkol aišše.
Fitor edde Yuhannaye manuš okkolore šikka dedde edde Isar duwara mora okkol abar uwafes uṛar babute tobolig goredde deki hitara beši gušša oiye.
Hitara Fitor edde Yuhannare doijje. He din hãzinna oi giyegoi buli tarforor din foijjonto hitarare ziyolot bon gori raikke.
Kintu hitara zara Fitoror boyan fuinne hitara boute biššaš ainne, henot biššaši furuš manuš okkolor dol barizaiyore hom beši fãs hazar oiye.
Ihudi okkolor neta okkol, murubbi okkol, edde alem okkol ekku fũwati Zeruzalem dola oiye.
He ḍõr imam Annas o heṛe hazir aššil, ar Kaifas, Yuhanna edde Alekzendar, edde he ḍõr imamor góror oinno manuš okkol o heṛe aššil.
Hitara Fitor edde Yuhannare hitarar sarmottu tiya goraiyore fusar goijje: "Tũwara kiyor šokti loi otóba har nam loi ei ham goijjo?"
Hetunot Fitore Pak Ruhuye furaiya oiyore hitarare hodde: "Ãrar neta okkol, murubbi okkol!
Ekzon ãtur manušore balai goijji buli zehon aijja ãrare zera gora or edde ei manušwa kengori bala oiye, he babute fusar gora or.

Henoile tũwara beggune edde har Israil zatiye, ei hota zani rako: Iyan Nasarator Isa Mosi loi, zare tũwara kurušor uwore mari felaila edde zare Allaye mora okkolor butottu tuille, hibar šokti loi ei manušwa furafuri bafe aram oiyore õnorar sarme tiyai roiye.
Hiba oilde

content.text: "'he fattor, zibare tũwara raz mistiri okkole bad diyo,
kintu hiba i har beggunottuwaro dorhari fattor oiye.'

content: Uddar ar honokiyor hãse fa no za, kiyollahoile asmanor nise manušor butore en ar hono nam diya no o, ze namor zoriya ãra uddar oi fari."
Hitara Fitor edde Yuhannar himmot deikke, ar itara ze anfora edde awam manuš hiyan dekiyore hitara tajjuf oiye, ar itara ze Isar fũwati aššil hiyan buzi faijje.
Aram oiyede manušwa, Fitor edde Yuhannar fũwati tiyat ase, dekiyore hitara itarar berudde hoibar ar kissu no aššil.
Etolla hitarare bisar šobattu bare zaibolla hokum diye edde hitara ekku fũwati biyasanat boišše.
Hitara hodde: "Ãra ei manuš okkolore loi ken goriyum? Zeruzalemot asede har kiye zane ze itara ekkan ḍõr keramoti ham goijje, ar hiyan ãra ošikar gori no fariyum.
Kintu iyan aro mainšor hãse sorai zai no farefan ei manuš okkolore domki diya foribo, toi zene itara ar honokiyore ei namor babute hono hota no ho."
Tarfore hitara Fitor edde Yuhannare abar butore ḍaki aniyore hokum diye, zene hitara Isar name hono hota no ho otóba šikka ebbere no de.
Fitor edde Yuhannaye zuwabe hodde: "Tũwarar hokum falon goijjum ne naki Allar hokum falon goijjum? Allar nozorot honnan ṭik, tũwara hiyan bisar gori so!
Kiyollahoile ãra zin dekki edde fuinni hinor babute no hoi tai no faijjum."
Toi hitarare aro sokto gori domki diyore eri diye. Kiyollahoile hitara itarare šaza dibolla hono ufai tuwai no fa, haron zin goṭṭil hinolla hár manuš okkole Allare tarif goijjil.
Ze manušware keramotir duwara aram gora oiye hitar umor sališ bosorottuwaro beši.
Isar sahabi okkolor munazat
Hitara hentu sara fai bade, hitarar nizor manuš okkolor hãse giye, ar ḍõr imam edde murubbi okkole zin zin hoil har kissu hitarare zanaiye.
Ei hota funiyore hitara beggune mili ek diyane Allar mutallek munazat gori hodde: "Oh Malik, tũi asman zobin, doriya, hinor butore ze kissu ase beggun sirišti goijjo.
Tũi Pak Ruhur duwara tũwar gulam ãrar fordada Daudor muk diyore howaila:

content.text: "'Har zatir manuš okkole kiyolla suhara oi sesamesi gorer?
Kiyolla manuš okkole hannak misa misi Allar berudde zar?
Duniyair badša okkole Mabud edde hibar Mosir berudde tiyaiye,
ar šašon goroya okkole ekkui fũwati oiye.'

content: Hendilla ode ode oiye, tũwar Paki gulam Isa, zare tũi Mosi hisabe basona goijjila, badša Herud edde Pontus Filate, ei šohorot hibar berudde Oihudi okkolor fũwati edde Israili okkolor fũwati hat milail.
Tũwar kuduruti edde issa mozin zin zin goṭibode tũi age loti ṭik gori rakkila, hitara hendilla goijje.
Ar ehon Mabud, itara ãrare ki bafe ḍor lagar tũi kiyal goror. Tũwar gulam okkolore endilla šokti do zene kub himmot loi hitara tũwar kalam hoi fare.
Tũwar hat barai do, zene tũwar Paki gulam Isar name hitara manuš okkolore aram gori fare edde keramot edde sinnor ham okkol gori fare."
Ze zagat hitara dola oiye, munazat gori bade he zagagan hafi uiṭṭe. Ar hitara beggune Pak Ruhuye furaiya oi fũwati šahoš loi Allar kalam howa šuru goijje.
Biššaši okkolor muhabbot
Har biššaši okkol beggunor mon dil ek aššil. Hitarar nizor dón šombottire nizor hoi dabi no gorito, kintu hitarattu zin aššil hinore beggun loi borat gorito.
Asab okkole ḍõr šokti loi goba diya šuru goijje ze Isa morattu zinda uṛi giyegoi, ar hitara beggunor uwore Allar ofurani rahamot aššil.
Hitarattu hono obafi manuš nuaššil, kiyollahoile zarattu zobin otóba gór aššil hitara hin okkol besi ṭĩya foiša anito,
edde asab okkolor ṭengor ḍake rakito. Bade zattu zendilla zorulot he bafe hitare diya oito.
Yusuf, Kiprus ḍiyar ekzon Levi. Hitare asab okkole Barnabas hoito, zar mani tuwajjo doyar fut.
Hitattu ekkan zobin aššil, hite hiyan besi ṭĩya ani asab okkolor ṭengor ḍake rakkil.
